title: Google Slides Solar Flare Presentation Screenshot
content: A UI screenshot of a Google Slides presentation open in a macOS Chrome browser window. The Chrome tab is labeled "Our Dynamic Sun - Google Slides". The active slide is dark-themed and titled "What Causes Solar Flares?" in large serif font with white and orange colors. On the right, a highly detailed graphic of the sun erupts with a bright orange solar flare. Beneath the header "THE SUN'S ENERGY IN ACTION", a horizontal process chart details four steps with circular minimalist icons, labeled "1. MAGNETIC FIELD TWISTING", "2. SUNSPOT ACTIVITY", "3. MAGNETIC RECONNECTION", and "4. ENERGY RELEASE" alongside brief paragraphs. The left sidebar displays six slide thumbnails. The overall design is professional, featuring deep black, orange, and white tones.
